name: Chronia
source:
Chronia is a short visual novel about an ordinary boy named Hayden who mysteriously obtained a watch as a gift for his birthday. Upon noticing that this watch had the capabilities of transversing through time, Hayden brings himself into a bad situation from his misuse and lack understanding of the concept of the watch. You must help Hayden make the right decisions in order to alter his fate with the use of time travelling.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Brixdee.Chronia]Google Play[/url]]
